title: ID0417992-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R5 170001866]-Engie VIANEO Charging issue
description:
Reported issue:
This charger has more than 20% of charging sessions that last less than 2 minutes. During the on-site investigation, I found that there was molten cooper on the DC pins of plug 2. For your information, I have disabled socket 2 for safety reasons.

Kindly check this issue and advise on how to proceed further.
